boundary: External papers are reality evidence and competing mechanism proposals. Inclusion does not promote their ontology, objective, algorithm, metric, or architecture into Ordivon.

optionValue.title: Irreversibility, Uncertainty, and Cyclical Investment
optionValue.mechanism: When action is irreversible and information arrives over time, waiting itself can have option value.

optionValue.title: The Value of Waiting to Invest
optionValue.mechanism: Simple invest-if-benefit-exceeds-cost rules miss the option value of delaying irreversible commitment.

optionValue.title: Uncertainty and Investment Dynamics
optionValue.authors: Nick Bloom; Stephen Bond; John Van Reenen
optionValue.source: NBER w12383 / Review of Economic Studies
optionValue.mechanism: Partial irreversibility makes higher uncertainty raise real-option value and delay investment/disinvestment.

optionValue.title: R&D Uncertainty and Cycles
optionValue.source: NBER w34838 / AEA Papers and Proceedings 116
optionValue.mechanism: Uncertainty can increase R&D/experimentation when investment itself resolves uncertainty; real options do not imply uniform caution.

optionValue.title: The Value of Information When Deciding What to Learn
optionValue.mechanism: Learning targets should balance performance shortfall, information required to identify the target, and information-acquisition efficiency.

optionValue.title: Finite-time Analysis for the Knowledge-Gradient Policy
optionValue.mechanism: Sequential choices can be valued by expected information gain and future decision improvement under structural assumptions such as adaptive submodularity.

regulation.title: Reward Tampering Problems and Solutions in Reinforcement Learning: A Causal Influence Diagram Perspective
regulation.authors: Tom Everitt; Marcus Hutter; Ramana Kumar; Victoria Krakovna
regulation.mechanism: If an agent can causally influence its reward process, self-serving reward tampering can become instrumentally useful; causal separation can remove this incentive.

regulation.title: Scaling Laws for Reward Model Overoptimization
regulation.authors: Leo Gao; John Schulman; Jacob Hilton
regulation.mechanism: Optimization against an imperfect proxy can improve proxy reward while degrading a stronger gold-standard objective.

regulation.title: Performative Prediction
regulation.authors: Juan C. Perdomo; Tijana Zrnic; Celestine Mendler-Dünner; Moritz Hardt
regulation.mechanism: A model's actions can change the future data distribution it is evaluated on; stability must be defined against post-action outcomes, not only historical data.

regulation.title: Is Pessimism Provably Efficient for Offline RL?
regulation.authors: Ying Jin; Zhuoran Yang; Zhaoran Wang
regulation.mechanism: Under incomplete coverage, uncertainty-aware pessimism can suppress spurious value extrapolation.

complementarity.title: The Shapley Taylor Interaction Index
complementarity.authors: Kedar Dhamdhere; Ashish Agarwal; Mukund Sundararajan
complementarity.mechanism: Attribution can require explicit interaction terms for subsets whose joint effect is not reducible to independent base effects.

complementarity.title: Regression-based causal inference with factorial experiments: estimands, model specifications, and design-based properties
complementarity.mechanism: Factorial experiments identify main and interaction effects under assignment rather than assuming additivity.

complementarity.title: Evolutionary Innovations and Where to Find Them
complementarity.mechanism: Expansive/transformational open-ended evolution may depend on multiple behavioral domains, trans-domain bridges, and non-additive compositional systems.

complementarity.title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET)
complementarity.authors: Rui Wang; Joel Lehman; Jeff Clune; Kenneth O. Stanley
complementarity.mechanism: Solutions can become unpredictable stepping stones whose transfer across generated problems unlocks capabilities not reached by direct optimization.

priorRevalidation.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
priorRevalidation.authors: Ryan Prescott Adams; David J. C. MacKay
priorRevalidation.mechanism: Track uncertainty over when the current generating regime began rather than assuming a stationary process.

priorRevalidation.title: Detecting and Adapting to Irregular Distribution Shifts in Bayesian Online Learning
priorRevalidation.authors: Aodong Li; Alex Boyd; Padhraic Smyth; Stephan Mandt
priorRevalidation.mechanism: Detect change and partially erase/temper past updates so old information loses authority after a regime shift.

priorRevalidation.title: Reset & Distill: A Recipe for Overcoming Negative Transfer in Continual Reinforcement Learning
priorRevalidation.authors: Hongjoon Ahn; Jinu Hyeon; Youngmin Oh; Bosun Hwang; Taesup Moon
priorRevalidation.mechanism: Old learned structure can actively harm new tasks; reset/distill can outperform approaches that merely preserve old capability.

priorRevalidation.title: Characterizing and Avoiding Negative Transfer
priorRevalidation.authors: Zirui Wang; Zihang Dai; Barnabás Póczos; Jaime Carbonell
priorRevalidation.mechanism: Transfer can be formally negative when source knowledge degrades target performance; relatedness must be tested rather than presumed.

identityUnderChange.title: An Empirical Characterization of Event Sourced Systems and Their Schema Evolution -- Lessons from Industry
identityUnderChange.authors: Michiel Overeem; Marten Spoor; Slinger Jansen; Sjaak Brinkkemper
identityUnderChange.mechanism: Evolving durable event systems use explicit versioning/upcasting/transformation strategies because historical evidence and current projections change at different rates.

identityUnderChange.title: Schema Evolution in Interactive Programming Systems
identityUnderChange.authors: Jonathan Edwards; Tomas Petricek; Tijs van der Storm; Geoffrey Litt
identityUnderChange.mechanism: Changing data shape requires explicit migration of both persisted data and programs; ad-hoc migration breaks fast feedback and collaboration.

identityUnderChange.title: Goedel Machines: Self-Referential Universal Problem Solvers Making Provably Optimal Self-Improvements
identityUnderChange.mechanism: A self-modification can be judged relative to a utility/evaluation rule that remains fixed during the proof of that modification.

identityUnderChange.title: What does a system modify when it modifies itself?
identityUnderChange.mechanism: Recent conceptual preprint: self-modification requires distinguishable mutable rules and a locally fixed evaluative core; identity under transformation remains an explicit open problem. Treat as hypothesis source, not established authority.

pressureSelection.title: CURIOUS: Intrinsically Motivated Modular Multi-Goal Reinforcement Learning
pressureSelection.mechanism: Goal practice can be allocated by learning progress, including returning to forgotten goals, within a predefined goal space.

pressureSelection.title: Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer (POET)
pressureSelection.mechanism: Problems and solutions can co-evolve inside a predefined environment space, with transfer between problem-solution pairs.

pressureSelection.title: Learning Curricula in Open-Ended Worlds
pressureSelection.mechanism: Unsupervised Environment Design generates training environments near the frontier of an agent's capability under a predefined design space and regret objective.

pressureSelection.title: Darwin Godel Machine: Open-Ended Evolution of Self-Improving Agents
pressureSelection.authors: Jenny Zhang; Shengran Hu; Cong Lu; Robert Lange; Jeff Clune
pressureSelection.mechanism: Maintain an archive of diverse coding agents, sample/modulate them, and empirically select improvements against external coding benchmarks; diversity preserves stepping stones.

pressureSelection.title: The AI Scientist-v2
pressureSelection.mechanism: Agentic tree search iterates hypothesis, experiment, analysis and manuscript generation inside a supplied scientific domain/evaluation pipeline.

pressureSelection.title: Towards an AI co-scientist
pressureSelection.mechanism: Generate/debate/evolve hypotheses conditioned on scientist-provided research objectives and prior evidence, using tournament-style selection.

pressureSelection.title: FirstResearch: Auditable Question Formation for LLM Scientific Discovery Agents
pressureSelection.mechanism: A Research Question Certificate exposes primitives, assumptions, mechanism, contradiction, falsifier, decisive test and failure update. Current evidence is preliminary and judge-based.

pressureSelection.title: Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas? A Large-Scale Human Study with 100+ NLP Researchers
pressureSelection.authors: Chenglei Si; Diyi Yang; Tatsunori Hashimoto
pressureSelection.mechanism: LLM ideation can score well on novelty while self-evaluation and diversity remain open weaknesses; end-to-end execution is needed to validate idea quality.
